system.description:
A creature suffering Star Sickness is suffering the radiation of overusing the meteors chakra.

A Star Sickened creature suffers a -2 penalty to all damage rolls they for each rank they have.

A Star Sickened creature makes Strength and Dexterity checks and saving throws at disadvantage.

A Star Sickened creatures with 3 or more ranks of this condition cannot regain hit points except from short or long rests.

A Star Sickened creatures with 5 ranks of this condition cannot regain hit points except by Long Rests.

If a Star Sickened creature is part of the Hoshi Clan, then ranks of this condition cannot be reduced by Non-Hoshi Clan features, Jutsu or effects if the creature afflicted.

A Star Sickened creature reduces this condition by 2 ranks at the conclusion of a Long Rest.
system.summary: −2 damage per rank; disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity checks and saves; healing limited at 3+ ranks; −2 ranks per long rest.

rules.text: At 3+ ranks it regains hit points only from short or long rests; at 5 ranks only from long rests. On a Hoshi, ranks can only be reduced by Hoshi Clan features, jutsu or effects.
